title: Provenance audit of catalog phnode_full clean seed42/46 fragility
notes: Four-phase provenance audit on branch provenance-audit-phnode_full (HEAD 7643dc9). Concludes that catalog-era phnode_full clean seed42/46 fragility was a cuDNN-coupled training divergence in catalog cloud mirror (auvhamnode/g3_5_5), not a model or git-code bug. Phase 3 audit on current main reproduces cleanrun v1 C46 bit-identically (60s clean pos_err_median = 0.4558 m). Catalog needs code_revision and environment fields to prevent recurrence.
